description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirror Image dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Mirror Image that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Mirror Image token instead.
